content.name: Chloe Nguyen
content.title: Marketing Manager
content.summary: QUT marketing graduate now running marketing for a fast-growing indoor climbing gym. Took memberships from 640 to 1,150 in 18 months on a modest budget by pairing community events with tightly targeted local ads.

experience.title: Marketing Manager
bullets: Run all marketing for a 1,800 sqm climbing and bouldering gym with an $85,000 annual budget, reporting membership and revenue results to the founders each month.
Grew active memberships from 640 to 1,150 through school-holiday programs, corporate team days and a refer-a-friend offer.
Launched a beginner intro session landing page with online booking, converting 31% of first-time visitors to paid memberships.
Secured three local business partnerships (a physio clinic, café and outdoor store) that share audiences and cut paid ad reliance by a quarter.
Brief and manage a casual videographer and two freelance designers, keeping a four-week content calendar.

experience.title: Marketing Assistant
bullets: Supported marketing for five clinics, writing blog posts and Facebook content that lifted organic website sessions by 38% year on year.
Set up Google Business Profiles and review requests for each clinic, adding 210 new five-star reviews in nine months.
Compiled monthly referral-source reports from Cliniko so practice managers could see which GP relationships drove new patients.

education.details: Distinction average. ATAR 91.4. Work-integrated learning project with a Brisbane craft distillery.

achievements.title: Membership milestone
achievements.detail: Passed the gym's 1,000-member target four months ahead of the founders' plan.

achievements.title: QUT case competition
achievements.detail: Runner-up in a faculty marketing case competition judged by local agency directors (2022).
